title: Current FlyLo continuation baseline
summary: FlyLo v0.4.11 is the current continuation baseline. It retains the durable v0.4.10 airline runtime, Accounting Core v0.7 and Wire UI Server v0.17, and fixes the sales passenger-step collection/count ambiguity. The canonical website startup is one package-root command: ./flylo.
invariants: Do not regress to multi-terminal or Python-sidecar startup.
Booking/inventory/passenger state is durable across launcher restarts.
passengerCount is numeric traveller count; passengers is the passenger-record collection.
Stable passenger identities use PAX-... semantic IDs.
The browser, Grok and Wire UI do not own booking/inventory/payment/accounting authority.

provenance.claim: FlyLo v0.4.11 passenger count/collection repair, durable baseline, launcher and dependency versions.
